Questions Sydney business owners ask first Straight answers on price, timing, platforms and ownership. How much does a website cost in Sydney? Website costs in Sydney vary widely depending on scope, design complexity, content, and whether you need e-commerce or custom features. It is common advice to get several written quotes and check exactly what is included, such as content, images, hosting, and maintenance. How long does it take to build a website? Timelines depend on the size of the site and how quickly content and approvals are provided. A standard business website typically takes 4 to 12 weeks to design and build, including discovery, design, development, testing, and content creation. How do I choose a web design company in Sydney?
